hooks.name: Block Gazebo Classic/Fortress names and ros2_control
hooks.description: Rejects writes to code/config files that use gazebo_ros_*, ignition-*, or ros2_control. Silent otherwise.

action.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.kiro/scripts/guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; python3 "$f" harmonic
